integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One continuous EIGHT-SECOND photographed live-action shot of Hiei preparing the Dragon of the Darkness Flame, arriving at the EXACT approved final photograph <Picture 1>. This is the preparation immediately BEFORE the approved attack, not another strike and not a replay. Hiei is the compact athletic young adult fictional Japanese male performer at LEFT: same angular face, spiky jet-black hair with pale front highlight, exactly one vertical violet Jagan eye in his forehead plus two natural eyes, torn sleeveless charcoal-navy cotton top, pale waist sash, loose dark fighting trousers and black boots. His RIGHT arm owns the black fire. Zeru is the taller separate blond adult male at RIGHT: short angular blond hair, square face, navy short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt, ivory loose trousers tucked into dark boots, ordinary orange fire only. Preserve real photographed skin pores, sweat, hair strands, cloth weave, seams and gravity. No actor likeness substitution, anime, cel shading, plastic skin, costume redesign, duplicate people, extra limbs, weapons, writing or subtitles. Use the SAME ring and fixed geometry as the approved picture: pale square-tiled elevated arena, existing cracks and scorch marks, LOW distant concrete perimeter retaining wall, audience seating above it, curved stadium canopy and cloudy sky. Keep the same horizon, overcast cool light and residual orange embers. Hiei stays west/left, Zeru east/right, cameras remain SOUTH of their action axis. No new tall wall, slab, portal, growing platform or changed canopy. The black-fire dragon has a dark core and thin violet flame edges, not solid scales or a bright generic energy beam.
Both fighters remain present and separate throughout. The image is the final composition and target pose, not the first frame. Do not begin with the fully formed dragon or spend eight seconds holding the final picture.
0.00–2.40 seconds: Start from a slightly closer front three-quarter view of Hiei at left, facing Zeru at right in the same stadium. Hiei has just stood firmly and opened his RIGHT hand at hip height. Only thin violet-black flame threads curl between his right fingers. His torn cotton top and pale sash remain exactly as in the approved final image; no new coat, bare torso or later dragon tattoo. He shifts his weight into a grounded wide stance, begins raising the RIGHT forearm toward the attack line and fixes his gaze on Zeru. The blond fighter follows that hand with his eyes and visibly stiffens; ordinary orange flame stays only near his fist.
2.40–5.70 seconds: Hiei's right shoulder and forearm rise into the outward position in the final photograph. Black flame grows directly FROM THAT RIGHT HAND into a turbulent serpentine column, then a clear long open-jawed dragon head forms ABOVE the space between the two fighters. Its core is black, with narrow violet burning edges. It is not a solid animal, portal or bright purple cloud. The camera makes a physical DOLLY BACK with a modest downward change of height, revealing more of Hiei's planted feet and the dragon's rising scale. Nearby tile joints move against distant stadium seating. The dragon's growing volume makes the framing widen naturally. Zeru stays at the same distance and begins a defensive weight shift, still unhurt.
5.70–8.00 seconds: The head lifts and curls into the exact overhead shape and direction in <Picture 1>. The camera eases into the approved low full-body composition with Hiei at LEFT foreground and Zeru at RIGHT middle distance, Hiei's right hand raised outward, left hand down, both sets of boots visible and canopy unchanged. Black flame remains visibly connected to Hiei's right hand; the head and trailing fire still flow and turn toward Zeru. Keep real breathing, cloth, hand tension and flame turbulence up to the final moment. Neither fighter is struck, no orange explosion occurs, no one disappears, and the attack has not launched. Do not freeze, reverse the same event or make the dragon grow from Zeru. End on the supplied approved photograph's physical configuration without a held tail.

overall_soundscape: Native synchronized diegetic sound only: distant nonverbal stadium ambience, subtle boots and clothing, restrained breathing, embers and evolving flame pressure. No words, dialogue, narration, invented shout, singing, chant, external music or cloned actor voice. Preserve the native H3 soundtrack for review. A low black-fire pressure rises progressively with the dragon's visible growth, without the impact roar of the attack that follows.
